why: XSPEC-458 R4 first run: every standard in the registry with none of {installed by init, named by the generated index, wrapped by a skill, checked, called by a workflow/hook/skill}, and every check script nothing calls. A debt register, not an exemption: the test fails on a new orphan, on an entry here that is no longer a finding, on an entry without a reason and owner, and after the expiry date.
howToShrink: Wire the standard (install by default, name it in a skill or hook, give it a check) or retire it, then delete its entry. If it stays on purpose, change the expiry and the reason in the same commit.
